open_mathematics: Necessary and sufficient general four-window Koszul/AS conditions and exhaustive explicit regular charts.
Component maximality and complete indexed isomorphism of the nine-dimensional image.
All higher Clifford obstruction equations and all one-period structures.
All global components, dimensions, period strata and degenerations.
Existence of a standard 14641 AS-regular indexed algebra that cannot be connected to any period-one object through regular flat families. The nonstandard helix example does not settle this.
interpretation_limits: The 9-to-15 comparison is of tangent spaces, not dimensions of irreducible components.
Equality of U(th) is necessary, not sufficient, for indexed isomorphism.
Z7 and Z9 are orbit-saturated closures of a single relation space, not asserted to be global coarse moduli spaces.
The boundary five-parameter family has generic minimal period two and lies in Z7; it is not an independently established component.
Eleven individually integrable tangent directions have the mixed obstruction lambda*c and do not yield a smooth simultaneous eleven-dimensional family.
